title: Mutually exclusive heating and cooling with deadband

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.

requirements.text: Heat shall turn on below Setpoint minus 1.0 while enabled and safe.
requirements.property: G((Enable AND !SafetyTrip AND Temperature < Setpoint-1.0) -> Heat)

requirements.text: Cool shall turn on above Setpoint plus 1.0 while enabled and safe.
requirements.property: G((Enable AND !SafetyTrip AND Temperature > Setpoint+1.0) -> Cool)

requirements.text: Neither output shall be active inside the inclusive deadband.
requirements.property: G((Temperature >= Setpoint-1.0 AND Temperature <= Setpoint+1.0) -> (!Heat AND !Cool))

requirements.text: Heat and Cool shall never be active together, and SafetyTrip shall turn both off.
